21. If the transaction manager transitions to the committed state at time T plus 1, then a commit message to every resource manager is sent at time T plus 1.
22. If the transaction manager transitions to the aborted state at time T plus 1, then an abort message to every resource manager is sent at time T plus 1.
23. A resource manager has received a commit message at time T if a commit message to that resource manager was sent at any time before or equal to T.
24. A resource manager has received an abort message at time T if an abort message to that resource manager was sent at any time before or equal to T.
25. If a resource manager is in the prepared state at time T, has received a commit message at time T, and has not crashed, then it transitions to the committed state at time T plus 1.
26. If a resource manager is in the prepared state at time T, has received an abort message at time T, and has not crashed, then it transitions to the aborted state at time T plus 1.
27. A resource manager that has crashed at time T remains crashed at all later times.
28. The transaction manager that has crashed at time T remains crashed at all later times.
29. A resource manager that has crashed does not change state.
30. The transaction manager that has crashed does not change state.
